run_register_sensors_and_measures: run the example script to register a custom measure and sensor in Habitat-Lab
create_custom_measure: create a custom Habitat measure class that tracks episode attributes and a custom value on reset
create_custom_sensor: create a custom Habitat sensor class that returns the agent position as a 3D observation
register_measure_with_config: register a new measure with Habitat using a dataclass config that extends MeasurementConfig
register_sensor_with_config: register a new sensor with Habitat using a dataclass config that extends LabSensorConfig
